description: Preserved conformal JCG108 antenna fairing concept for a 90 mm tube. Valid reference geometry is not a qualified manufactured or purchased product.
releaseRequirements: Resolve aerodynamic loads, local compressibility and flow separation for the actual operating environment. The 300 m/s design case is not a demonstrated speed rating.
Qualify structural, thermal, material, layer-bonding and fastener performance before fabrication or operational use.
Measure the delivered JCG108 housing, adhesive layer, cable outlet, boot and minimum coax bend radius. The library antenna remains a nominal source reference, not a resized mounting solid.
Resolve the actual anchor support and captive nut structure. The two M3 screw axes and nominal nut radii are retained interface datums, not a complete host mounting design.

The nominal 1 mm authored perimeter is a tube-supported transition only. Native spline interpolation must be checked separately; edge bonding and finishing are required. It is not a free-standing structural fin.
Inspect the supported printing orientation and actual 256 mm bed clearance. This family is an independent future design study and is not included in the Grandado mounting kit.
